# authsignal_tenant_settings (Resource)

Manages webhook, session, and network settings for the existing tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authsignal_tenant_settings" "tenant_settings" {
  token_duration_in_minutes = 15

  authenticator_events_webhook_config = {
    url                           = "https://example.com/authsignal/authenticator-events"
    include_credential_public_key = true
  }

  log_events_webhook_config = {
    endpoint_url = "https://example.com/authsignal/log-events"
  }

  ip_whitelist = ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.7/32"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `authenticator_events_webhook_config` (Attributes) Authenticator events webhook. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator_events_webhook_config))
- `ip_whitelist` (Set of String) IPv4 ranges in CIDR notation allowed to call the Server API. Set to `[]` to allow every address.
- `log_events_webhook_config` (Attributes) Log events webhook. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_events_webhook_config))
- `token_duration_in_minutes` (Number) Challenge token lifetime in minutes. Also sets the pre-built UI session length.

<a id="nestedatt--authenticator_events_webhook_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticator_events_webhook_config`

Required:

- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint for authenticator events.

Optional:

- `include_credential_public_key` (Boolean) Whether passkey `authenticator.created` events include the credential public key.


<a id="nestedatt--log_events_webhook_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `log_events_webhook_config`

Required:

- `endpoint_url` (String) HTTPS endpoint for batched log events.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import authsignal_tenant_settings.tenant_settings ""
```
